today_summary: GCM26 prints $3,853 with ATM IV at 24.89% — the highest reading of the 5-day window and a $60 (1.57%) 1σ daily envelope. Spot sits in an air pocket $47 below the $3,900 put wall (6,328 contracts) with no call OI of consequence until $4,100, so overhead supply is thin but the nearest real floor is $3,700 (6,040). Net GEX within ±$200 of spot is -430.6, and every strike from $3,700 to $4,050 prints negative gamma — dealers are short gamma through the entire active corridor and only turn long at $4,100 (+21.4). Session volume was light and call-skewed (6,350 calls vs 1,558 puts), but the heaviest prints were deep-ITM $2,500 and $1,500 calls, which is roll mechanics rather than directional conviction.
five_day_thesis: The decisive change over five sessions is the gamma regime, not the price: net GEX in the ±20% window flipped from +79.6 on 2026-11-11 to -232.6 on 2026-11-13 and has deepened every session since, to -255.3 — three consecutive days of vol-amplifying dealer posture where the first two days of the window were stabilizing. Spot has carried $177 lower (4,030.1 → 3,853.1, -4.39%) and ATM IV has expanded 22.05% → 24.89% (+2.84pp), the opposite of the premium decay that normally accompanies a drift lower — falling price with rising vol is a distribution signature, not a controlled pullback. The put wall has been unstable all week, migrating 3,700 → 3,700 → 3,500 → 3,900 → 3,500, meaning the market has not agreed on a floor; the $3,900 strike that was being defended on 2026-11-16 is now overhead supply with spot beneath it. Positioning has quietly grown more call-heavy — call OI +7,241 to 300,736 while put OI shed 2,344 to 117,986, pushing P/C OI to 0.39 from 0.41 — but that OI is stacked at $4,500–$5,500, far above the market, so it offers no near-term support. Max pain is pinned at $5,225 (one-day blip to $5,300 on 2026-11-16, then back), $1,372 above spot: at that distance it is a legacy-OI artifact, not a magnet, and the tradable structure is the wall ladder, not the pin.

Put wall migrated 3,700 → 3,500 → 3,900 → 3,500 across the window — no agreed floor, and $3,900 flipped from defended strike to overhead supply
Call OI built +7,241 to 300,736 against put OI -2,344 to 117,986, taking P/C OI to 0.39 — but the build sits at $4,500–$5,500, far out of play
Call wall unchanged at $5,500 (16,547) for all five sessions — the ceiling has not moved once

prediction: Bias bearish below $3,900. With dealers short gamma from $3,700 to $4,050 and no call OI until $4,100, the path of least resistance is a grind toward the $3,800 put shelf (2,563) and then the $3,700 wall (6,040), with the negative-GEX corridor amplifying any break rather than cushioning it. A sustained reclaim of $3,900 invalidates the short thesis and opens a thin-air squeeze to $4,000–$4,050, where today's 714-lot call volume clustered.
